prompt: Can you review this profile-update route before I open the PR? It's a Fastify handler that upserts a user's profile row.

assertions.text: Flags z.any() on the `metadata` field as unsafe and recommends z.unknown() (or a concrete shape) instead
Flags calling .parse() directly on req.body (untrusted user input) and recommends .safeParse() so invalid input doesn't throw an unhandled error
Flags the object schema missing .strict() before the parsed values are persisted, noting unknown/extra fields from the request body would silently pass through
